Class Hdf5Dataset

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.hdf5.Hdf5Dataset
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class Hdf5Dataset extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Thin wrapper around a 1-D HDF5 dataset. Owns its dataset id; released in close().

Datasets are created with a definite element count and precision; the shape cannot be resized after creation.

    • getPrecision

      public Enums.Precision getPrecision()
      Returns:
      the precision (element type) the dataset was created with.

    • getLength

      public long getLength()
      Returns:
      the total element count along all axes. For a 1-D dataset this equals the single dimension; for N-D datasets it is the product of all extent values.

    • writeData

      public void writeData(Object data)
      Write all elements.

      The data parameter type depends on the precision:

      • FLOAT32: float[]
      • FLOAT64: double[]
      • INT32: int[]
      • INT64: long[]
      • UINT32: int[] (interpreted as unsigned)
      • COMPLEX128: double[] with length 2*N (re,im pairs)
      Parameters:
      data - array of the appropriate primitive type for this dataset's precision

    • readData

      public Object readData()
      Read all elements. Return type matches the precision (see writeData(Object)).

    • setStringAttribute

      public void setStringAttribute(String name, String value)
      Write a UTF-8 string attribute on this dataset.

      Emits a VL_STRING with UTF-8 character set so Python and ObjC readers can consume the attribute byte-equivalently. Mirrors Hdf5Group.setStringAttribute(String, String).

      Parameters:
      name - the attribute name (replaces any existing entry)
      value - the UTF-8 string payload

    • readStringAttribute

      public String readStringAttribute(String name)
      Read a UTF-8 string attribute from this dataset.

      Decodes both VL_STRING and fixed-length string attributes. Returns null when the attribute is absent or the attribute's HDF5 type class is not H5T_STRING. Callers are expected to dispatch on the return type — null indicates "not a string-typed attribute, try a numeric reader".

      Parameters:
      name - the attribute name
      Returns:
      the decoded string, or null when the attribute is absent or non-string typed

    • setUint8Attribute

      public void setUint8Attribute(String name, int value)
      Write a uint8 (one-byte) integer attribute on this dataset.

      The @compression attribute used for codec dispatch on signal channels carries this datatype (H5T_NATIVE_UINT8).

      Parameters:
      name - the attribute name (replaces any existing entry)
      value - the unsigned 8-bit integer payload (masked to 0x00..0xFF)
